title: Our Intellectual Superiors!
text:
I occasionally come across statements by our Woke, Progressive betters that so illuminate the vast superiority of their intellect that they simply must be acknowledged.
Let’s begin with the blathering of a celebrity actor who shares with us lowly plebes the deep truth about “Free Palestine.”
I’ll close with what is perhaps the most naked acknowledgement of the intellectual foundation for Woke, Progressive thought.
These two are representative of a significant cohort within the Woke Progressive community. The next time you are confronted by one of these people posturing as intellectually superior, ask for some basic information that justifies their position. In some cases you may get an interesting response. But don’t be surprised if many give you the look of consternation that a little plebe like you dares to ask a question of their better, followed by a blank look covering for the void where an answer should be.
